newsitem.title: USA: Miami suburb Sunny Isles to vote on incorporation.
newsitem.headline: Miami suburb Sunny Isles to vote on incorporation.

text.p: Voters will decide Tuesday whether the Miami suburb of Sunny Isles will incorporate as a city.

The Atlantic coast neighborhood, in the northeast part of Dade County, currently receives services through the county. Proponents said local needs are often ignored by the 13-member county commission and incorporation would give residents more control.
If the referendum is approved, the county would appoint a committee to select a form of government and draft a charter, which would then go before voters.
Sunny Isles would become the 30th municipality in the county, which encompasses Miami, joining a trend of wealthy unincorporated areas pulling away from the county government.
